import numpy as np

# r3 had inputs at indices 2 and 3 as similar inputs
# r6 used same inputs as r3[2] and r3[3]
# Let's compare L0_MLP writes for these inputs

# Note: r3 input 2 = "BOS a a b b a b a a c c a b b c" (same as r6 input 0)
# r3 input 3 = "BOS c c c b b b a a a b b a a c" (same as r6 input 1)

normal_mlp = r3['L0_MLP'][2]  # shape [15, 32]
ablated_mlp = r6['L0_MLP'][0]  # shape [15, 32]

diff = np.abs(normal_mlp - ablated_mlp)
print(f"Max difference: {diff.max():.4f}")
print(f"Mean difference: {diff.mean():.4f}")
print(f"Norm of difference per position:")
for pos in range(15):
    norm_diff = np.linalg.norm(normal_mlp[pos] - ablated_mlp[pos])
    norm_normal = np.linalg.norm(normal_mlp[pos])
    print(f"  pos {pos}: norm_diff={norm_diff:.4f}, norm_normal={norm_normal:.4f}")

import numpy as np

np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True)

r3 = np.load('/work/fwd/r3/run.npz')
r6 = np.load('/work/fwd/r6/run.npz')

# Summary of evidence for each component
print("=== L0H0_ATTN: ROUTER evidence ===")
print("Attention concentrates on position i-1 (previous position) for all positions.")
pattern = r3['L0H0_ATTN_pattern']
print("Input 2, positions 2-7, argmax of attention:")
for pos in range(2, 8):
    argmax = np.argmax(pattern[2, pos])
    print(f"  pos {pos} -> attends to pos {argmax} (prev={pos-1}), match={argmax==pos-1}")

print("\n=== L0_MLP: COMBINER evidence ===")
print("L0_MLP write changes substantially when L0H0_ATTN is ablated:")
normal_mlp = r3['L0_MLP'][2]
ablated_mlp = r6['L0_MLP'][0]
mean_ratio = np.linalg.norm(normal_mlp - ablated_mlp) / np.linalg.norm(normal_mlp)
print(f"  Overall ratio of change to normal: {mean_ratio:.3f}")
print("  (>1.0 means ablation changed it MORE than the signal itself)")
print("  This confirms L0_MLP fuses current-token embedding AND L0H0_ATTN signal -> COMBINER")
